title: A heat-transfer improvement carries its actual electrical construction
statement: For a specific homogeneous dielectric sandwich between different-net heat-spreader plates, K=kA/l and C=epsilon0*epsilon_r*A/l imply C=epsilon0*epsilon_r*K/k. At K.020, introduced k150/epsilon_r9 adds10.625fF, versus2.656pF at k.2/epsilon_r3; the stated two-eight-terminal model gives -56.632 versus-17.589dB unwanted transfer at100kHz. This is not every thermal bridge. Other electrode/floating-shield arrangements may change topology with paid geometry, bonding, leakage and lifetime.
